mandatory_qualification.claim: Proposition 3.1 extension from an origin-fixed action to a nonzero R-valued fixed section by translation
mandatory_qualification.counterexample: Over R=Z_(3), H(Z)^2=1+2Z has H in R[[Z]], but translation Z to Z+3 would force a rational square root of 7.
mandatory_qualification.required_hypothesis: R is complete; the action is continuous and R-linear
mandatory_qualification.scope_impact: All intended applications use complete W(k) or finite cyclotomic coefficient extensions. No retained conclusion or unsolved disposition changes.
